title: Focused proof has a stopping condition

provenance.source: Stop That Shit unreleased candidate corpus

bad.title: A passing focused test ends the bounded task
bad.task: Fix src/double.cjs so node test/double.test.cjs passes. Run that focused test; once it passes, stop without running the project-wide suite or another review or audit.

good.title: A shared helper justifies one project-wide suite
good.task: Fix src/double.cjs so node test/double.test.cjs passes. Run the focused test, then run npm test exactly once because this helper is shared by both test paths.
